title: You all blow me away, this is my first attempt - Arkham Survey
author: FDGF_UK
selftext:
Im a big fan of the LoveCraftian mythos. My first AI game is a glimpse into another world of Arkham. Whilst the player does not directly control the investigations or investigators, there are aspects which give limited influence to an NPC. Imagine yourself in a dark world with strange happenings, your dreams are slowly driving you crazy with what you've seen. A stranger keeps mailing you information on leads that blow your theories out od the water. 

You, the viewer are thar outside intrusion. You can see and investigate the same as the NPCs to understand the story and how they are coping literally. Influence them enough, they need to take time away to bring their senses back down to earth. Mail them a lead, and sometimes they may even write back...not always with your advice heeded.

The game is autonomously updated monthly with a new story and lead, new investigator.

I strongly recommend reading the tutorial as you start, and if you want to go deeper browse the field guide. If you enjoy the mythos, id love some feedback!
